observation_summary: The solver failed to throw an IllegalArgumentException when provided with an initial guess and endpoints that did not bracket a root.
reasoning_summary: The BrentSolver implementation failed to validate the bracketing condition when an initial guess was provided. The Javadoc explicitly states that an IllegalArgumentException should be thrown if the function values at the endpoints and the initial guess do not bracket a root (i.e., they have the same sign). The fix introduces a check to verify that the function values at the interval endpoints have opposite signs before proceeding with the solver, ensuring the contract defined in the documentation is upheld.
